# url plugin


```````````````````````````````` example
visit https://lepture.com/
.
<p>visit <a href="https://lepture.com/">https://lepture.com/</a></p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
visit [https://lepture.com/](/foo)
.
<p>visit <a href="/foo">https://lepture.com/</a></p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
visit <a href="/foo">https://lepture.com/</a>
.
<p>visit <a href="/foo">https://lepture.com/</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) for more
.
<p>see <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language)">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language)</a> for more</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
read https://example.com/a_(b_(c)).
.
<p>read <a href="https://example.com/a_(b_(c))">https://example.com/a_(b_(c))</a>.</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
(see https://example.com/a_(b))
.
<p>(see <a href="https://example.com/a_(b)">https://example.com/a_(b)</a>)</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
(see https://example.com/)
.
<p>(see <a href="https://example.com/">https://example.com/</a>)</p>
````````````````````````````````
